name: connection-magic-blueprint
description: Research an audience, uncover current pain points, choose strong short-form video topics, and create platform-specific scripts.

interface.shortDescription: Research audiences and write short-form videos.
interface.longDescription: An audience-first content workflow that researches current pain points, proposes 20 relevant video topics, and turns a selected idea into an Instagram Reels, TikTok, or dual-platform production script with a chosen CTA.
defaultPrompt: Research my audience and give me 20 video topics.
Turn my rough idea into a short-form video script.
Create distinct Instagram and TikTok versions of my topic.
